title: FLEX Table IX: results by test number
description: Every FLEX droplet-combustion test on the ISS, March 2009 to December 2011: fuel, ambient pressure and composition, initial droplet diameter, visible-flame extinction diameter, burning-rate constant (linear fit of droplet diameter squared versus time), burn time and how the test ended. Microgravity (ISS).

source.title: Detailed Results From the Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX) March 2009 to December 2011 (NASA/TP—2015-216046)
source.locator: Table IX, pp. 20–28; column definitions p. 19
